DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Supranuclear Palsy (PSP).

The clinical picture of a 70-year-old man with asymmetric, progressive resting tremor, recent falls or instability (implied by difficulty with steadiness), and early cognitive decline (memory loss affecting finances) is highly suggestive of PSP. I need to confirm if he has experienced any difficulty looking up or down, or any issues with swallowing, and check for postural instability. REQUEST TEST: Brain MRI.
